(Trigger warning: the following is roleplay that includes manipulative and gaslighting language. If you'd prefer me not to continue, tell me and I'll stop.)

What are you even upset about? I can't believe you're making such a huge deal out of nothing. You always blow things out of proportion — remember last time? You said the same things, just like now. I was with friends, that's it. You heard things from someone who clearly has an agenda. Why would I hurt you? You know me better than that.

If I wanted to, I would have told you. But instead you're choosing to believe strangers over me. That really hurts. It's like you want to pick a fight. And now you're accusing me of cheating? Do you even listen to yourself? You're acting paranoid and it's exhausting. Honestly, sometimes I think you're trying to control me — making up reasons to check my messages, interrogate me, ruin everything we have.

I don't know why you can't just trust me. We have problems because you keep making things personal and dramatic. If you keep accusing me, I can't stay when I'm being treated like I'm the bad guy for no reason. Maybe you should look at your own behavior instead of projecting. I love you, but I won't be screamed at for things that never happened.

(If you want me to stop roleplaying or want to switch to something supportive — talking through what actually happened, how to set boundaries, or resources for coping with betrayal — say so and I’ll help.)
